# Twilio MCP connector

Let your AI work with Twilio: send and look up SMS and WhatsApp messages, review calls and phone numbers, check numbers with Lookup, send and check one-time codes with Verify, and keep an eye on usage, costs and balance. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 20 MCP tools for Twilio: 15 read and 5 can change data.

[![Open Twilio in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dtwilio&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=twilio)

**Category:** [Messaging](../messaging.md) · **Tools:** 20 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/twilio-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/twilio-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/twilio-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/twilio-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/twilio-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/twilio-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/twilio-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Twilio connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Twilio connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your Twilio account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/twilio-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-twilio-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-twilio-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-twilio-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-twilio-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-twilio-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-twilio-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Show the SMS to customer +358407712345 sent on 2026-09-15 about order INV-2026-078.*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Twilio API<br/>api.twilio.com"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, user name and password" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Twilio credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (user name and password), calls Twilio, logs the call and returns the result.
- **Twilio** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/twilio.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/twilio.json).

### `twilio_get_account`

Read the Twilio account the connector works with: friendly_name, status (active, suspended, closed), type (Trial or Full), owner_account_sid and date_created. Needs the Auth Token or a Main API key; a Standard API key may be refused here (401 or 403, error 20003) while every other tool works.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}.json`

No parameters.

### `twilio_get_balance`

Read the account balance and its currency. Subaccounts answer with the balance of the main account.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Balance.json`

No parameters.

### `twilio_list_messages`

List SMS, MMS and WhatsApp messages of the account, newest first, with sid, from, to, body, status (queued, sending, sent, delivered, undelivered, failed, received, read), direction, num_segments, price, error_code and date_sent. Filter by number and date. The answer has messages[] and next_page_uri (null on the last page); messages is empty on an account that never sent one.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Messages.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | string | no | Only messages sent to this number, E.164 (e.g. +4915112345678) or whatsapp:+4915112345678. |
| `from` | string | no | Only messages sent from this number or sender, E.164 or whatsapp:+E164. |
| `date_sent` | string | no | Only messages sent on this day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). |
| `date_sent_after` | string | no | Only messages sent on or after this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). |
| `date_sent_before` | string | no | Only messages sent on or before this time, ISO 8601. |
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 0. Pass it together with page_token from the previous answer's next_page_uri. |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from the previous answer's next_page_uri, for the next page. |

### `twilio_get_message`

Read one message by its sid (SM... or MM...): status, error_code and error_message when it failed, price, segments, sender and recipient, and the times it was created, sent and updated.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Messages/{message_sid}.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_sid` | string | yes | The message sid, e.g. SM1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef. |

### `twilio_send_message`

Send an SMS, MMS or WhatsApp message. This sends a real message to a real person and costs money, so confirm the recipient, sender and text with the user first. Set from (a Twilio number in E.164, an alphanumeric sender id, or whatsapp:+E164) or messaging_service_sid, and body or content_sid. For WhatsApp, prefix both numbers with whatsapp: (e.g. whatsapp:+4915112345678); outside the 24-hour window after the user last wrote, WhatsApp only accepts approved templates (content_sid plus content_variables). Returns the message with sid and status (usually queued); read it later with twilio_get_message for the delivery status.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Messages.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | string | yes | Recipient in E.164 (e.g. +4915112345678), or whatsapp:+E164 for WhatsApp. |
| `from` | string | no | Sender: a Twilio phone number in E.164, an alphanumeric sender id, a short code, or whatsapp:+E164. Leave out when messaging_service_sid is set. |
| `messaging_service_sid` | string | no | Messaging Service sid (MG...) to send through instead of from; required for scheduled messages. |
| `body` | string | no | Message text, up to 1600 characters. Leave out when content_sid sends a template. |
| `media_url` | string | no | Public URL of one image or file to attach (MMS in the US and Canada, or WhatsApp media). |
| `content_sid` | string | no | Content template sid (HX...) to send, e.g. an approved WhatsApp template. |
| `content_variables` | string | no | Values for the template placeholders as a JSON string, e.g. {"1":"Anna","2":"12:30"}. |
| `status_callback` | string | no | URL Twilio calls with every status change of the message. |
| `schedule_type` | `fixed` | no | "fixed" to schedule the message for send_at (needs messaging_service_sid). |
| `send_at` | string | no | When to send a scheduled message, ISO 8601, 15 minutes to 35 days ahead (e.g. 2026-10-12T09:00:00Z). |
| `validity_period` | integer | no | Seconds the message may wait in the queue before Twilio gives up, 1 to 36000. |
| `shorten_urls` | boolean | no | true to shorten links in the body (needs a Messaging Service with a verified link domain). |

### `twilio_cancel_scheduled_message`

Cancel a message that was scheduled with schedule_type fixed and has not been sent yet; its status becomes canceled. Confirm with the user first.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Messages/{message_sid}.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_sid` | string | yes | The sid of the scheduled message (SM...). |

### `twilio_list_message_media`

List the media (images, files) attached to an MMS or WhatsApp message, with each item's sid and content_type. The file itself is at https://api.twilio.com plus the item's uri without the .json ending.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Messages/{message_sid}/Media.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_sid` | string | yes | The message sid (SM... or MM...). |
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 0. Pass it together with page_token from the previous answer's next_page_uri. |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from the previous answer's next_page_uri, for the next page. |

### `twilio_delete_message`

Delete a message record from the account for good, including its body. Only possible once the message is no longer queued or sending. Installed switched off; confirm with the user first.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `DELETE /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Messages/{message_sid}.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_sid` | string | yes | The message sid (SM... or MM...). |

### `twilio_list_calls`

List phone calls of the account, newest first, with sid, from, to, status, direction, duration (seconds), price, start_time and end_time. Filter by number, status and start day. The answer has calls[] and next_page_uri; calls is empty on an account without calls.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Calls.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | string | no | Only calls to this number, E.164. |
| `from` | string | no | Only calls from this number, E.164. |
| `status` | `queued` \| `ringing` \| `in-progress` \| `canceled` \| `completed` \| `failed` \| `busy` \| `no-answer` | no | Only calls with this status. |
| `start_time_after` | string | no | Only calls started on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `start_time_before` | string | no | Only calls started on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 0. Pass it together with page_token from the previous answer's next_page_uri. |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from the previous answer's next_page_uri, for the next page. |

### `twilio_get_call`

Read one call by its sid (CA...): status, direction, from and to, duration, price, answered_by, parent_call_sid and the start and end times.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Calls/{call_sid}.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call_sid` | string | yes | The call sid, e.g. CA1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef. |

### `twilio_list_phone_numbers`

List the phone numbers the account owns, with sid (PN...), phone_number, friendly_name, capabilities (voice, sms, mms, fax), the voice and SMS webhook URLs and the date bought. Use them as from in twilio_send_message. The answer has incoming_phone_numbers[] (empty when the account owns none).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/IncomingPhoneNumbers.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phone_number` | string | no | Only numbers that contain these digits, e.g. +4930 or 555. |
| `friendly_name` | string | no | Only numbers with exactly this friendly name. |
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 0. Pass it together with page_token from the previous answer's next_page_uri. |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from the previous answer's next_page_uri, for the next page. |

### `twilio_get_phone_number`

Read one owned phone number by its sid (PN...): number, capabilities, webhooks, emergency address status and bundle.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/IncomingPhoneNumbers/{phone_number_sid}.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phone_number_sid` | string | yes | The phone number sid, e.g. PN1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef. |

### `twilio_list_messaging_services`

List the Messaging Services of the account (Messaging API v1), with sid (MG...), friendly_name, use case and settings. A Messaging Service sends from a pool of numbers and is required for scheduled messages. The answer has services[] and meta with the next page URL.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET https://messaging.twilio.com/v1/Services`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, up to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from meta.next_page_url of the previous answer. |

### `twilio_lookup_phone_number`

Look up a phone number with Lookup v2. Without fields it is free and checks the format, returning valid, validation_errors, country_code, calling_country_code, national_format and phone_number in E.164. Data packages in fields are billed per lookup: line_type_intelligence (mobile, landline, VoIP and carrier, about 0.008 USD), caller_name (US only), sms_pumping_risk, line_status, reassigned_number (US only), identity_match (needs more arguments, not offered here), sim_swap and call_forwarding (private beta). Ask before requesting a paid package.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET https://lookups.twilio.com/v2/PhoneNumbers/{phone_number}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phone_number` | string | yes | The number, ideally in E.164 (e.g. +4915112345678); a national number needs country_code. |
| `fields` | string | no | Comma-separated data packages to add, e.g. line_type_intelligence or line_type_intelligence,sms_pumping_risk. Leave out for the free basic check. |
| `country_code` | string | no | ISO country code to read a national-format number with, e.g. DE (Twilio assumes US otherwise). |

### `twilio_list_verify_services`

List the Verify services of the account (sid VA..., friendly_name, code_length, enabled channels). A Verify service is needed to send and check one-time codes; create one in the Twilio Console under Verify, Services. The answer has services[] (empty when there is none).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, up to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from meta.next_page_url of the previous answer. |

### `twilio_send_verification`

Send a one-time code through a Verify service by SMS, voice call, WhatsApp or email. This contacts a real person and each verification is billed, so confirm the recipient and channel with the user first. Returns the verification with sid (VE...) and status pending. Check the code the person received with twilio_check_verification within 10 minutes.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/{service_sid}/Verifications`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service_sid` | string | yes | The Verify service sid (VA...), from twilio_list_verify_services. |
| `to` | string | yes | Phone number in E.164 (e.g. +4915112345678), or an email address for the email channel. |
| `channel` | `sms` \| `call` \| `whatsapp` \| `email` \| `auto` | yes | How to send the code. |
| `locale` | string | no | Language of the message, e.g. de, en, it, fr. Defaults to the language of the recipient's country. |
| `custom_friendly_name` | string | no | Name shown in the message instead of the service's friendly name. |

### `twilio_check_verification`

Check the code a person received from twilio_send_verification. Returns status approved when the code is right, pending when it is wrong (the person may try again), and valid true or false. Once approved, or after 10 minutes, the verification is closed and a new one is needed.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/{service_sid}/VerificationCheck`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service_sid` | string | yes | The Verify service sid (VA...). |
| `to` | string | no | The phone number or email the code was sent to, exactly as in the verification. |
| `verification_sid` | string | no | The verification sid (VE...) instead of to. |
| `code` | string | yes | The code the person entered, 4 to 10 characters. |

### `twilio_get_verification`

Read a verification by its sid (VE...): to, channel, status (pending, approved, canceled, max_attempts_reached, deleted, failed, expired), the send attempts and when it was created. Only verifications of the last 10 minutes or so can be read.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET https://verify.twilio.com/v2/Services/{service_sid}/Verifications/{verification_sid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service_sid` | string | yes | The Verify service sid (VA...). |
| `verification_sid` | string | yes | The verification sid (VE...). |

### `twilio_list_usage_records`

List usage and cost per category for a date range: category, description, count with count_unit, usage with usage_unit, price and price_unit. Without dates Twilio covers the whole account history. Category totalprice gives the total spend. The answer has usage_records[].

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Usage/Records.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | string | no | Only this usage category, e.g. sms, sms-outbound, calls, calls-inbound, phonenumbers, lookups, verify-totp-attempts, totalprice. |
| `start_date` | string | no | First day, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative value like -30days. |
| `end_date` | string | no | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative value like +0days. |
| `include_subaccounts` | boolean | no | false to leave out the usage of subaccounts (default true). |
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 0. Pass it together with page_token from the previous answer's next_page_uri. |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from the previous answer's next_page_uri, for the next page. |

### `twilio_list_usage_records_by_period`

List usage and cost per category split into periods (one record per category and day, month or year), or for a fixed window: Today, Yesterday, ThisMonth, LastMonth, AllTime. Each record has start_date, end_date, count, usage and price. Pass category to keep the answer short (e.g. totalprice for spend per day).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}/Usage/Records/{period}.json`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | `Daily` \| `Monthly` \| `Yearly` \| `Today` \| `Yesterday` \| `ThisMonth` \| `LastMonth` \| `AllTime` | yes | How to split or which window. |
| `category` | string | no | Only this usage category, e.g. sms, sms-outbound, calls, calls-inbound, phonenumbers, lookups, verify-totp-attempts, totalprice. |
| `start_date` | string | no | First day, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative value like -30days. |
| `end_date` | string | no | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative value like +0days. |
| `include_subaccounts` | boolean | no | false to leave out the usage of subaccounts (default true). |
| `page_size` | integer | no | Results per page, 1 to 1000 (default 50). |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, starting at 0. Pass it together with page_token from the previous answer's next_page_uri. |
| `page_token` | string | no | PageToken from the previous answer's next_page_uri, for the next page. |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Twilio** and enter `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_API_KEY_SID`, `TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
